topic: Propensity-hinge completeness frontier for divergence-based causal bounds. In the binary-treatment bow ADMG with consistency, positivity and mutual absolute continuity, prove that the compatible marginal laws of Y(a) are exactly Q=eP+(1-e)R with R absolutely continuous with P. For every finite continuous convex f with f(1)=0, characterize equality between this set and the Jung-Kang ball D_f(P||Q)<=e f(1/e)+(1-e)f(0): modulo affine terms, f must vanish on [0,1/e] and be strictly positive above 1/e. Prove an open strict-containment region for every failing generator, exact piecewise CDF endpoints with attaining SCMs, and simultaneous endpoint inference. Apply the legality correction to itbound and IHDP.

open_problems.open_problem: Which finite continuous convex f-generators make the Jung-Kang propensity ball exactly equal to the bow-ADMG compatible mixture class, and does every failing generator produce a nonempty open region of ball-feasible but SCM-illegal laws, including when f is nondifferentiable or piecewise linear with a zero interval beyond 1/e?

source_refs.claim: Derives the propensity-only bound D_f(P||Q)<=e f(1/e)+(1-e)f(0) and optimizes over the resulting ball, but does not give a generator-level iff for equality with SCM-compatible laws.
source_refs.author: Yonghan Jung and Bogyeong Kang
source_refs.venue: Proceedings of the Fifth Conference on Causal Learning and Reasoning, PMLR 323

source_refs.claim: Studies f-divergences under bounded relative information and the E_gamma hinge divergence, the closest information-theoretic machinery for detecting a one-sided likelihood-ratio cap.
source_refs.author: Igal Sason and Sergio Verdu

source_refs.claim: Shows that extremal problems under finitely many f-divergence constraints reduce to small finite alphabets, supporting a binary boundary and open-gap analysis.
source_refs.author: Adityanand Guntuboyina, Sujayam Saha, and Geoffrey Schiebinger

source_refs.excerpt: JungKang2026 substitutes an f-divergence budget but does not name an extremal latent coupling.

open_problems.why_unsolved: The web literature supplies three components but not their conjunction: a universal propensity-calibrated outer inequality, hinge divergences that detect likelihood-ratio violations, and finite-alphabet reduction. Prior CausalSmith work independently flags the missing latent extremizer and the need for open, not isolated, cap separation. The obstacle is generator equivalence under affine additions: necessity must normalize f, infer its whole zero region from equality of law sets, and then upgrade a boundary violation to strict divergence slack. Smooth first-order arguments do not cover kinks, affine pieces, or canonical generators whose zero set continues beyond the cap, so these cases require a fully quantified binary boundary-equality and outward-continuity dichotomy.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: An iff theorem, modulo affine generator terms, proving that equality for all mutually absolutely continuous P,Q holds exactly when the normalized f vanishes on [0,1/e] and is strictly positive above 1/e, plus for every failing f either a binary illegal law with an open illegal neighborhood inside the ball or a characterized counterexample to that open-gap claim.

writing_exemplar.why: Its progression from unmeasured confounding to a propensity-only divergence radius is the closest framing, with completeness and legality of that radius as the new destination.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Unmeasured confounding prevents point identification -> propensity alone yields a computable divergence radius -> causal validity requires knowing exactly when that ball equals the SCM-compatible law set and when its excess has interior

method_exemplars.technique: Adapt affine normalization, functional domination, bounded-relative-information arguments, and the E_gamma hinge to turn divergence constraints into pointwise likelihood-ratio restrictions.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The exact bow compatibility class is a one-sided likelihood-ratio cap, so hinge-divergence zero sets expose precisely the geometry the iff must recover.

method_exemplars.technique: Reduce measure-space divergence geometry to binary probability vectors and solve the resulting constrained convex problem exactly.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The early-kill step needs a binary law that simultaneously violates the cap and has strict divergence slack, after which continuity gives an open neighborhood.

open_problems.open_problem: What are the exact pointwise CDF envelopes of Y(a) over Q=eP+(1-e)R with R absolutely continuous with respect to P, including atoms and degenerate boundary cases, and can every endpoint be attained by an explicit bow-ADMG SCM satisfying consistency, positivity, and mutual absolute continuity?

source_refs.claim: Optimizes expectations of user-selected functions over a propensity-calibrated divergence ball; indicator functions target counterfactual CDF values but inherit any excess laws in that relaxation.
source_refs.author: Yonghan Jung and Bogyeong Kang
source_refs.venue: Proceedings of the Fifth Conference on Causal Learning and Reasoning, PMLR 323

source_refs.claim: Introduces fixed-nominal-component contamination neighborhoods, whose event-probability extrema have the same linear mixture geometry as the proposed compatible marginal class.
source_refs.author: Peter J. Huber

source_refs.claim: Certifies sharp causal bounds by optimizing over admissible response-function SCMs, but the automated construction is for variables with known discrete support.
source_refs.author: Guilherme Duarte, Noam Finkelstein, Dean Knox, Jonathan Mummolo, and Ilya Shpitser
source_refs.venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association

open_problems.why_unsolved: Huber contamination makes scalar event-probability optimization elementary, but it does not show that an extremal residual distribution is a potential-outcome marginal of the specified bow graph. General response-function programs provide SCM sharpness mainly for discrete variables. The first proof step that changes is therefore the realization step: replace an arbitrary contaminating law by a joint latent construction for (A,Y(0),Y(1)) that reproduces the observed arm, the propensity, and the chosen residual law while preserving mutual absolute continuity. Atoms and the cases P(Y<=y)=0 or 1 require separate attainment checks and can invalidate formulas copied from an unconstrained divergence dual.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: Piecewise lower and upper formulas for Pr(Y(a)<=y) at every y, with an explicit latent-variable bow-ADMG SCM attaining each endpoint in every boundary regime and a matching impossibility proof outside the interval.

writing_exemplar.why: It motivates distributional causal targets under unmeasured confounding and supplies the relaxation whose endpoint claims require a lawful replacement.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Unmeasured confounding leaves the interventional outcome distribution unidentified -> divergence optimization gives generic distributional bounds -> exact causal interpretation requires closed-form lawful CDF envelopes and attaining SCMs

method_exemplars.technique: Optimize event probabilities by allocating the contamination component to the event or its complement, then track domination restrictions at atoms.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The counterfactual marginal class has exactly the fixed-component-plus-residual form on which these event extrema are based.

method_exemplars.technique: Canonicalize an SCM into response types and certify sharpness by exhibiting admissible structural parameters.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The missing step is not scalar CDF optimization but proving every extremal residual law has a compatible structural realization.

method_exemplars.technique: Estimate indexed sharp bound functions and calibrate a nonstandard bootstrap for uniform bands.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Once the pointwise lawful endpoints are established, they form a two-sided indexed partial-identification envelope requiring process-level rather than scalar inference.

open_problems.open_problem: Do the pointwise sharp propensity-mixture CDF intervals paste into a single compatible counterfactual distribution, and if not, what is the exact finite-grid and continuum criterion for a whole endpoint curve to be generated by one residual law R absolutely continuous with respect to P?

source_refs.excerpt: a curve drawn by stacking sharp pointwise intervals may not itself correspond to any single latent law
state the exact necessary-and-sufficient coupling criterion and make the closed-form CDF envelope only a lemma
the upper support endpoint, where any valid CDF must equal 1

open_problems.why_unsolved: The archived proposal and reviewer isolate a genuine process-pasting failure: a different R can attain each scalar threshold, while one reported CDF curve must come from a single monotone, right-continuous probability law with the correct limits and R<<P. Thus endpointwise SCM witnesses do not prove simultaneous curve attainability. The first proof step changes from optimizing R independently at each threshold to characterizing the image of the whole residual-CDF cone under F_Q=eF_P+(1-e)F_R, including support endpoints and null sets of P.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A necessary-and-sufficient finite-grid polytope and continuum function-space characterization of attainable CDF curves, together with the smallest counterexample whenever the coordinatewise pointwise hull is strictly larger than that process identified set.

writing_exemplar.why: Its distributional partial-identification framing is a suitable model for motivating why entire CDF and quantile objects, rather than isolated scalar thresholds, matter.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Relaxing unconfoundedness yields distributional bounds -> applications report whole CDF or quantile curves -> coordinatewise sharp values need not share one latent distribution -> characterize the jointly attainable process

method_exemplars.technique: Adapt sharp distribution and quantile restrictions under partial independence, but impose a common residual probability measure across all thresholds before inversion.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Both problems concern an identified set for a complete counterfactual distribution under a relaxation of unconfoundedness.

method_exemplars.technique: Estimate bound functions on finite grids and extend inference to the continuum using monotonicity and a nonstandard bootstrap.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The proposed compatibility map is an indexed distributional identified set, so a finite-grid-to-continuum inference construction is directly reusable after identification.

open_problems.open_problem: Can one construct simultaneous confidence bands for both lawful propensity-mixture CDF endpoints over every threshold and treatment arm that remain uniformly valid at endpoint atoms, cap contacts, and positive-mass active-face ties when the propensity and observed CDF are estimated?

source_refs.claim: Provides Neyman-orthogonal root-n inference for a divergence-bound objective, but not an l-infinity limit theory for an indicator-indexed pair of lawful CDF endpoint processes.
source_refs.author: Yonghan Jung and Bogyeong Kang
source_refs.venue: Proceedings of the Fifth Conference on Causal Learning and Reasoning, PMLR 323

source_refs.claim: Constructs nonstandard-bootstrap confidence bands uniform over a sensitivity index for treatment-effect bound functions, but not over outcome thresholds for propensity-mixture CDF endpoints.
source_refs.author: Matthew A. Masten, Alexandre Poirier, and Linqi Zhang
source_refs.venue: Journal of Business and Economic Statistics

source_refs.excerpt: No current theorem in the core supplies the tie-uniform bootstrap approximation and inversion argument
Uniform tau-curve inference at active-piece switches is explicitly open.
a complete uniform theory requires weak convergence in ell^infty

open_problems.why_unsolved: Web and prior-proposal evidence converge on the same obstacle: scalar orthogonality and pointwise regular-stratum influence functions do not control a threshold-indexed max/min process when active pieces switch. The first proof step must be a uniform linearization of the pre-hinge empirical process, followed by the directional derivative of the cap map. Endpoint atoms and positive-mass ties can make the ordinary bootstrap inconsistent and can destroy any single active-face derivative, while existing uniform sensitivity bands index a scalar relaxation parameter rather than the paired CDF endpoints and treatment arms.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A cross-fitted endpoint-process estimator with an ell-infinity functional CLT and a derivative-estimated multiplier or numerical-delta bootstrap whose critical value gives asymptotically honest simultaneous coverage of both endpoint functions over thresholds and treatment arms on a stated tie-inclusive law class.

writing_exemplar.why: It clearly explains why an entire identified-bound curve requires uniform rather than pointwise uncertainty quantification.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Sensitivity analysis produces indexed lower and upper bounds -> pointwise intervals under-cover after inspecting a curve -> propensity-mixture CDF endpoints add threshold kinks and active-face ties -> simultaneous tie-robust bands are required

method_exemplars.technique: Prove Hadamard directional differentiability of the nonsmooth endpoint map and use a derivative-aware bootstrap rather than the inconsistent ordinary bootstrap.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The lower and upper CDF maps contain caps and competing active faces whose derivative changes at ties.

method_exemplars.technique: Derive process approximations for estimated bound functions and calibrate a nonstandard bootstrap supremum statistic.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It directly solves simultaneous inference for two-sided partial-identification envelopes, with the indexing variable changed from sensitivity level to CDF threshold.

method_exemplars.technique: Use cross-fitting and Neyman-orthogonal scores to make first-order propensity and outcome-law nuisance error vanish, then control product-rate remainders.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The endpoint process depends on flexible estimates of both the propensity and conditional outcome CDF before the nonsmooth hinge is applied.

open_problems.open_problem: For each failing generator and bounded causal query h, when does enforcing the exact likelihood-ratio cap strictly change the Jung-Kang bound, and how should that query-specific legality gap be propagated through itbound's multi-divergence aggregation and the reported IHDP analysis?

source_refs.author: Jacob Dorn and Kevin Guo

source_refs.author: Jacob Dorn, Kevin Guo, and Nathan Kallus
source_refs.venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association

source_refs.excerpt: quantify how that exclusion changes a causal-bound map

open_problems.why_unsolved: Strict containment of feasible law sets does not imply that every linear causal query has different extrema: some h expose a common face of the exact mixture cone and relaxed divergence ball. The prior reviewer explicitly asks for the missing move from an illegal-law witness to a changed bound map, while Dorn-Guo supplies a precedent in which enforcing the exact compatible class repairs asymptotically over-wide sensitivity bounds. The first proof and implementation step is to derive the support-function difference between the two sets, characterize its zero directions, and obtain a tractable primal or dual for the intersection with dP/dQ<=1/e before multi-divergence aggregation; no located source performs this correction or re-audits IHDP.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A dual formula for the query-specific legality gap with an iff zero-gap condition and an open positive-gap theorem, followed by a constrained itbound algorithm proved valid and weakly tighter and a reproducible before-and-after audit of all affected IHDP endpoints and coverage summaries.

writing_exemplar.why: It supplies the exact software-facing narrative, supported divergences, aggregation rule, and IHDP benchmark that a legality correction must address.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Propensity-only divergence bounds enable practical software -> generic balls can contain structurally illegal laws -> whether illegality changes a reported query depends on exposed faces -> enforce the exact cap and reassess itbound and IHDP

method_exemplars.technique: Replace a loose weight optimization by the exact compatible class, derive its quantile-balancing dual, and prove attainability of the corrected extrema.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It is the direct econometric precedent for diagnosing a causally over-wide bound and repairing it by imposing the actual compatibility restriction.

method_exemplars.technique: Dualize exact robust optimization into an estimable regression form, then construct doubly-valid and doubly-sharp estimators with confidence intervals.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The corrected divergence problem likewise needs an exact constrained dual whose empirical version preserves both causal sharpness and coverage.

method_exemplars.technique: Recompute optimized partial-identification endpoints inside a percentile bootstrap using tractable fractional programs.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It provides a practical resampling template for software whose reported interval is itself the solution of a constrained optimization.

literature_map:
Jung and Kang (2026, CLeaR, PMLR 323, arXiv:2601.17160) derive the propensity-only f-divergence radius, convex optimization, orthogonal estimation, aggregation, and IHDP results.
Ali and Silvey (1966, JRSSB, DOI:10.1111/j.2517-6161.1966.tb00626.x) provide the foundational convex-generator formalism and affine-generator equivalence.
Sason and Verdu (2016, IEEE TIT, arXiv:1508.00335) study bounded relative information and E_gamma hinge divergences, the nearest machinery for detecting a likelihood-ratio cap.
Guntuboyina, Saha, and Schiebinger (2014, IEEE TIT, arXiv:1302.0336) reduce constrained f-divergence extrema to small finite alphabets, supporting the binary early-kill analysis.
Agrawal and Horel (2021, JMLR, arXiv:2006.05973) give variational and topological results relevant to upgrading strict containment to an open illegal region.
Huber (1964, Annals of Mathematical Statistics, DOI:10.1214/aoms/1177703732) supplies the fixed-component contamination geometry Q=eP+(1-e)R.
Kassam (1981, IEEE TIT, DOI:10.1109/TIT.1981.1056314) treats density-band uncertainty, the robust-testing analogue of a likelihood-ratio cap.
Manski (1990) is the foundational no-assumption causal-bounds anchor but does not give the present unbounded distribution-law characterization.
Tan (2006, JASA, DOI:10.1198/016214506000000023) introduces the propensity-centered marginal sensitivity framework.
Zhao, Small, and Bhattacharya (2019, JRSSB, arXiv:1711.11286) give optimized bootstrap inference, but their population relaxation can be too wide.
Dorn and Guo (2023, JASA, arXiv:2102.04543) restore sharpness by optimizing over exact compatible weights, the closest precedent for a legality correction.
Dorn, Guo, and Kallus (2025, JASA, arXiv:2112.11449) combine exact DRO duality, semiparametric efficiency, double sharpness, and double validity.
Masten, Poirier, and Zhang (2024, JBES, arXiv:2012.15716) establish uniform confidence bands for sensitivity-bound functions, the nearest process-inference exemplar.
Duarte et al. (2024, JASA, arXiv:2109.13471) certify sharp SCM bounds by response-function programs for discrete variables; the continuous bow-mixture witness is an analytic extension.
